title: How to Stop Mind Wandering During Work: The Focus Mistake to Avoid
description: Learn how to stop mind wandering during work and create a calmer, more focused routine without fighting every thought. This guide explains why attention drifts, how your environment affects concentration, and practical ways to improve focus, mindfulness, and productivity habits. Discover the four-step attention reset that helps you notice distractions and return to your task with more control. Tap to read the full guide.
alt_text: Infographic showing a focused person working at a desk with visual cues for reducing distractions, organizing tasks, and practicing mindfulness to stop mind wandering during work.
hidden_hook: The article reveals the four-step attention reset: notice your mind has drifted, avoid judging yourself, identify where attention went, and return to the task.
